**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (¶¶ p0082–p0084) is the only audit right binding us, and it already sits at the playbook's **preferred** position:

| Material term | Preferred | Document |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | ≤ once / 12 months | once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing/manner | business hours | normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | independent, confidentiality-bound | same, off-site where practicable ✓ |
| Cost | Vendor unless underpayment > 5% | Vendor unless > five percent ✓ |
| System access | none | Vendor/auditor may not access Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material ✓ |

Section 22.3 gives us extra protection (findings are our Confidential Information, copy of final report, payment resolves the audited quantity). I confirmed via section listing and a full-text search for "audit"/"inspect" that no broader inspection or verification right exists elsewhere — § 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) has a heading only, with no operative text, so nothing to police there.
